## Literature

* Farrell, S., & Lewandowsky, S. (2018). *Computational modeling of cognition and behavior.* Cambridge University Press. [eBook](https://eur.on.worldcat.org/oclc/1028902356)

The links above point to the online resources of the literature. Books and articles that are not listed here can be downloaded from the Canvas page.

Please note that some of the references are only accessible from the university campus. To access these materials from home, you need to set up a [VPN connection (on-campus simulation)](https://www.eur.nl/en/library/using-library/access-online-collection).
